responses.text: So you're the one that saved President Kimball. Damn glad to have you on our side.
What can I help you with?
I heard there was an attempt on President Kimball's life. I'm glad he's alright. Don't know what the NCR would do without him.
I've had to increase security around the Strip due to the President's assassination. I can barely believe he's dead myself.
So you're the one causing all the ruckus at The Tops. You're lucky you're not under my jurisdiction or I'd have tossed you in a cell for that.
I heard you killed Benny over at The Tops. I bet you think you're some sort of tough cookie.
A piece of advice, if you mess with any of my men, you'll regret it.
I wanted to thank you for stopping the Omertas. That could have gone poorly for us if it wasn't for you.
I hear you've been meeting with Mr. House in the Lucky 38. I bet you think you're pretty special, don't you?
Special or not, stay out of trouble and more importantly stay out of my way.
What the hell is with those Securitrons? Looks like they got some sort of change or upgrade. I don't like the look of this.
I heard Mr. House is out of the picture now. Guess that leaves us in charge of the Strip.
Make it quick, I've got a shitstorm to deal with due to the damn monorail being blown up.
So you're the one running errands for Ambassador Crocker. I don't want to know details, just don't cause any trouble.
Keep your nose clean on the strip, soldier.
{Surprised, Happy} Wow, I didn't expect to see you here. What can I do for you?
Good to see you around here. What can I do for you?
{Threatening} You make one wrong move around here and I'll be all over you in a heartbeat. You hear me?
{Threatening} You better watch yourself around here.
You've got a lot of nerve showing your face around here. You're lucky I don't shoot you right now.
You better have a good reason for being here.
So you're the new hotshot on the Strip. Just because you can walk around on the Strip with your guns doesn't make you a big shot.
You make any trouble for me or my men and I'll make sure you regret if for a very long time. You got that?
Now are you here for something or are you just wasting my time?
Make it quick.
<Captain Marie Pappas Top Level Topics>
More of the usual. We're keeping an eye on the troopers to make sure they don't do anything stupid.
The only stupid one we've had lately is Private Erwin. He's starting to cause me more trouble than he's worth.
None of your business. You better keep your nose clean because I'll be watching you.
People drink, gamble, and fight. What do you think happens on the Strip? Any other intelligent questions?
How the hell did a brahmin get loose on the Strip? If this is another one of Private Erwin's pranks, I'll make him regret it.
I've got to deal with drunk troopers making fools of themselves and embarassing all of the NCR with their behavior, so it's just another day here.
Some idiot decided it would be funny to put up graffiti all over the Strip. If I find out it was one of my men, they'll be locked up for a month.
Some fool troopers think they can lounge around on the rooftops instead of doing their job. If I catch them, they'll have KP duty for a year.
Some drunk girls thought it would be fun to play in the fountain in front of the Ultra-Luxe. Now I need to clean up the mess.

topics.prompt: What is happening on the Strip?

responses.text: Not much to tell. Keeping the troopers in line and monitoring the Strip keeps me busy. It's my job and I'm going to do it well.
Now if that's all, I've got work to do.
Look, I don't know you at all and I'm not really interested in small talk. If you have something important to say, do so quickly.

topics.prompt: I'd like to know more about you.

responses.text: Crocker isn't too bad. He mostly stays in his office now. If you have any questions about the Embassy you should ask him. He'll talk your ear off.
If you want to know more about the Ambassador, go talk to him yourself.

topics.prompt: What can you tell me about the Ambassador?

responses.text: Private Erwin... he's starting to get a thick file here with all his troublemaking.
My troopers are my business. Stay out of it.
Murder? What kind of Murder? Do you have any proof?

topics.prompt: I'd like to report a murder at Gomorrah.

responses.text: Okay, this is a very serious accusation. Please be sure to bring me something concrete.
Well that's something, but I can't go in there without proof of foul play.

topics.prompt: I found a dead girl in Gomorrah.

responses.text: These are terrifying. Do you have any idea who the man is speaking on this tape?
Well come back here when you can. I'd like to take care of this as soon as possible.
Come back here as soon as you do, I'd like to see this asshole behind bars.

topics.prompt: No, but I'll find out for you.

responses.text: Clanden? Okay, I'll send some troops over there to bring him in.
